messages.subject: Dynamic Tabs with Reactive Names
parts:
Dear all,

I'm very new to shiny and am experimenting a number of features with a view to incorporating them into a bigger project.

The idea is that the user may enter the number of tabPanels AND rename them.

I've been able to make the number of tabPanels using Ramnath's code here (http://stackoverflow.com/questions/19470426/r-shiny-add-tabpanel-to-tabsetpanel-dynamicaly-with-the-use-of-renderui).

But I've been far less succesful trying to allow the user to rename the tabs. I copy my flawed attempt below: all tabs are renamed simultaneously with names like "Case 1", "Case 2", etc. rather than separetely with unique names as in "Case of the Rue Morgue", "Case of the dog in the nighttime", etc.. 

I'd appreciate suggestions!

Thanks:

library("shiny")
runGist("https://gist.github.com/anonymous/7369572")


# server.R

library("shiny")

shinyServer(
 
  function(input, output, session){

    output$myInput = renderUI({ 
      nInput = input$nInput
      name = input$name
      myInput = lapply(paste(name, 1: nInput), tabPanel)
      do.call(tabsetPanel, myInput)
    })
   
    output$myName = renderUI({numericInput("name", 'Name', "Case")})
      
  }
)

# ui.R

shinyUI(

  pageWithSidebar(
 
    headerPanel('Dynamic Tabs')
    ,
    sidebarPanel(
      numericInput("nInput", 'Number of Cases', 1)
    )
    ,
    mainPanel(
      uiOutput('myInput')
      ,
      uiOutput('myName')
    )
  )
)
